retrievalMethod: Orca browser / male cookie / HTML listing
limitations: Source is the FC27 Career Mode HTML listing, not a raw EA game database export.
Financial values are converted from displayed K/M figures and may be rounded by the website; original strings are retained.
Individual profile attributes and birthdates are not collected by the player listing crawl; league IDs are stored in clubs.json and leagues.json.
The ordinary listing does not identify every loan. isOnLoan is null unless explicitly displayed.
Snapshot date is checked on every downloaded page; the website does not expose the active snapshot ID in these links.
No FC26 rows, EA dataset, financial estimates, or local FC27 file are used to fill missing values.
completeScope: All male players in the selected FIFACM listing snapshot; individual profile attributes are outside this crawl.

clubs.selection: Only club IDs referenced by the existing male players.json; other catalogue teams are excluded.
limitations: The team catalogue does not display a squad snapshot date. Player and club retrieval dates are recorded separately.
Clubs without players in the male dataset are outside this selection; national teams are stored separately in national-teams.json.
Financial numbers are copied from HTML data-worth/data-budget attributes, not inferred from rounded card labels.
Source-zero budgets are preserved as zero and are unverified; zero should not be interpreted as a confirmed usable budget.
League IDs are source-linked; default club lineups are stored in startingXI. Manager and stadium names are not collected.

leagues.selection: Only groups with source-confirmed memberships among the existing male clubs; groups without selected clubs are excluded.
limitations: Source pages do not display a snapshot date.
teamIds contains only clubs in clubs.json; sourceTeamCount may be larger.
Group membership follows FIFACM, including continental competitions and any provider-specific group names.

nationalTeams.selection: All teams in the FC27 International group with the Male database selected.
limitations: National playerIds are the source-selected squad, not every eligible player of that nationality.
Some source rosters and pitch lineups omit players; financial totals cover only the displayed playerIds, not a verified complete national squad.
International is a source group; it is not added to the club-only leagues.json relationships.

formations.normalization: Basic shape IDs with id/label/lines; original source builder definitions retained in variants.

nations.source: Distinct players.json nationality objects, grouped by original ID.
nations.nationalTeamNationMethod: National team nationId is the single nationality.id shared by every player in its source-selected roster.
limitations: This is the nationality catalogue represented by the existing players; it is not a complete list of countries worldwide.
References are stored on players and national teams; the nationality catalogue does not store reverse membership lists.

teamProfiles.financialScope: Full source roster; derived sum of player value/wage.
teamProfiles.formationMethod: National-team definitions only: exact starting-position multiset match. Clubs do not use builder definitions.
teamProfiles.clubFormationStatus: Inferred basic shape from startingXI positions; null for incomplete or unrecognized lineups.

clubMetrics.squadValueEur: Sum players[].valueEur for the current club.playerIds.
clubMetrics.weeklyWageEur: Sum players[].wageEur for the current club.playerIds; EUR per week.
clubMetrics.worthEur: Preserved source HTML data-worth value; distinct from total player value.
clubMetrics.financialScope: Current playing roster, including substitutes and reserves. Loaned-in players count at the playing club; salary sharing, loan fees, bonuses, staff wages and loaned-out wages are not known.
limitations: Player financial amounts may already be rounded by FIFACM.
weeklyWageEur is the listed player wage total, not a verified club accounting payroll or spending limit.
Formation is an inferred basic shape, not a source-confirmed tactical variant. startingXI preserves original positions. Unknown or incomplete patterns remain null.

optimization.format: JSON array, one compact player object per line

avatarRecheck.source: Male FC27 listing HTML: .player-img-info data-lazy-src or src, joined by player ID.
avatarRecheck.scope: Source-declared image URLs; CDN availability and unique real portraits are not guaranteed.
